resources.string: Point at the QR code on your desktop exam screen

Phone camera is required for every exam.

1. On the exam PC, open the phone QR step.
2. Tap Scan Desktop QR below (or use Chrome to scan).
3. Allow camera when asked.
4. Wait until it says Paired — keep this app open.

Phone + PC must be on the same Wi‑Fi (not guest / mobile data).
